entities.summary: Oleksandr Heorhiyovych Dombrovskyi is a Ukrainian politician. He served as a member of the Verkhovna Rada from Ukraine's 11th electoral district from 2012 to 2019,. and as Governor of Vinnytsia Oblast previously from 2005 to 2010.
